# Library check codes

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-check-docs.mjs (repository tooling that does not ship). Edit src/catalog-core/check-guidance.ts or src/catalog-core/dogfood.ts and regenerate. -->

Read each finding's actual severity, subject and message. An error fails the check; a notice or warning is reported without making the engine verdict fail. A notice is not proof that an unmeasured check passed.

Fix operations below are proposals from the current ChangeSet vocabulary. They never run automatically and do not grant permission to write. Some corrections require catalog ownership or external evidence rather than any operation. The chooser never authors values; authored values must come from the consumer.

Only currently typed codes appear here. Component, section and frame checks are unavailable until implemented; future K, CC, SK and FK codes need runtime guidance when added to Finding.code.

## C1

A value, member name, identifier or fill does not match its contract.

- Severity: error.
- Typical cause: Malformed values, unsafe CSS, an unknown closed member, or an unsupported mode.
- Proposed fix ops: `author`, `adopt`.
- Next action: Propose consumer-supplied corrected values or a valid candidate. A catalog contract defect needs its owner; do not invent a new leaf.

## C2

A dependency cannot be followed safely.

- Severity: error.
- Typical cause: Missing or undeclared reads, an upward dependency, a cycle, or an alias chain longer than 16 hops.
- Proposed fix ops: `author`, `adopt`, `derive`, `remove`.
- Next action: Propose a fill with declared, resolvable lower-layer inputs; remove only if the consumer explicitly no longer needs the leaf.

## C3

A standards claim lacks a valid clause or evidence, or a fixed scale is overridden.

- Severity: error or notice.
- Typical cause: Unknown clauses, absent evidence, unavailable path verification, or an intentional scale override.
- Proposed fix ops: `author`, `adopt`.
- Next action: Obtain real evidence or a conforming fill. An unverified path remains unverified; a fixed-scale notice needs explicit review. Catalog clauses and evidence metadata may require owner correction outside a ChangeSet.

## C4

Required coverage or a CSS binding is missing or inconsistent.

- Severity: error or notice.
- Typical cause: An unfilled leaf, missing member, orphan fill, duplicate CSS binding or unbound shipped token.
- Proposed fix ops: `adopt`, `author`, `derive`, `remove`.
- Next action: Propose a materialized fill for missing coverage. Ask the catalog owner to correct binding defects; removal alone does not satisfy required coverage.

## C5

A member does not have one consistent implementation.

- Severity: error.
- Typical cause: Multiple consumer fills for a leaf or a supplied resolved snapshot that differs from fresh resolution.
- Proposed fix ops: `remove`, `adopt`, `author`.
- Next action: Recompute a stale snapshot. For duplicate fills, propose one replacement after explicit removal; do not keep competing implementations.

## C6

A licence or external source receipt is missing or inconsistent.

- Severity: error.
- Typical cause: An unsupported licence, missing external pin, or disagreement between source, fill and origin receipts.
- Proposed fix ops: `adopt`, `author`.
- Next action: Obtain the real licence and pinned receipt, then propose a valid adoption. Authored content needs its own true licence; never relabel copied work to bypass this finding.

## C7

A fill is not a consumer implementation for this library.

- Severity: error.
- Typical cause: A reference fill or a fill naming another consumer source was copied directly.
- Proposed fix ops: `adopt`, `author`.
- Next action: Propose a consumer adoption or explicitly supplied authored fill; catalog reference material is not an implementation.

## C8

Stable status has no valid owner sign-off.

- Severity: error.
- Typical cause: Stable metadata lacks an owner identity, date or reference.
- Proposed fix ops: none.
- Next action: Request actual owner sign-off or an owner-approved status correction. No ChangeSet operation grants promotion authority; never fabricate approval.

## C9

A declared token contrast pair fails or cannot be measured.

- Severity: error.
- Typical cause: Insufficient foreground/background contrast in light or dark mode, or unresolved colour values.
- Proposed fix ops: `author`, `adopt`, `derive`.
- Next action: Propose consumer-approved colours or a registered derivation with resolvable inputs, then recheck both modes. Do not invent a passing colour.

## C10

Provenance, materialization or generated selection is inconsistent or stale.

- Severity: error or notice.
- Typical cause: Modified adopted bytes, upstream drift, invalid origin data, stale derivation inputs or selection drift.
- Proposed fix ops: `adopt`, `author`, `derive`.
- Next action: Propose explicit re-adoption for upstream changes, consumer-authorized authorship for changed content, or re-derivation through the registered rule. Preserve rationale; do not hand-edit hashes to conceal drift.

## A1

An asset lacks an acceptable licence and adoption trail, or live text needs font evidence.

- Severity: error or notice.
- Typical cause: Absent licence/pin/hash, or a lockup containing live text whose font must be provided.
- Proposed fix ops: `adopt`, `author`.
- Next action: Obtain the real artwork and font licences and receipts. Propose a valid fill; retain required fonts and notices for live text.

## A2

An SVG fails the supported closed grammar.

- Severity: error.
- Typical cause: Unsupported SVG markup or a non-text SVG value.
- Proposed fix ops: `author`, `adopt`, `derive`.
- Next action: Propose supplied artwork using the accepted grammar or a registered derivation. Do not suppress rejected content or introduce an unchecked temporary SVG.

## A3

An icon glyph violates its rendering shell contract.

- Severity: error.
- Typical cause: Incorrect 24-grid shell, fill, currentColor stroke or stroke width.
- Proposed fix ops: `adopt`, `author`.
- Next action: Propose a contract-conforming glyph from a valid source or consumer-supplied geometry.

## A4

Icon bounds or source consistency need measurement or review.

- Severity: error or notice.
- Typical cause: Geometry leaves the 2px inset, bounds were not measured, or icon sources are mixed.
- Proposed fix ops: `adopt`, `author`.
- Next action: Obtain geometry measurements and review mixed-source consistency. Propose replacement glyphs only from approved material. Missing measurements do not prove a pass.

## A5

Identity artwork contrast fails or is unmeasured on a required ground.

- Severity: error or notice.
- Typical cause: Insufficient paint contrast or absent/unsupported paint and background values.
- Proposed fix ops: `author`, `adopt`, `derive`.
- Next action: Propose approved identity variants or a registered derivation and remeasure light, inverse and dark grounds.

## A6

Favicon inks are invalid or 16px optical review remains outstanding.

- Severity: error or notice.
- Typical cause: Missing explicit light ink or isolated dark-scheme ink rule; no browser legibility evidence.
- Proposed fix ops: `derive`, `author`, `adopt`.
- Next action: Propose a valid favicon, then ask the owner to inspect it at 16px in the browser. Structural success does not complete optical review.

## A7

The monochrome mark fails single-colour legibility.

- Severity: error.
- Typical cause: The supplied mono variant does not satisfy the single-colour check.
- Proposed fix ops: `author`, `adopt`, `derive`.
- Next action: Propose approved single-colour artwork or a registered derivation; retain owner visual review.

## A8

App icon safe area, backdrop or corner treatment is invalid or unmeasured.

- Severity: error or notice.
- Typical cause: Maskable artwork escapes the 80% circle, its full-bleed ground is not opaque, standard corners are not transparent, or variants are missing.
- Proposed fix ops: `derive`, `author`, `adopt`.
- Next action: Propose valid standard and maskable variants, then recheck the safe area and transparency.

## A9

Icon ink contrast fails or cannot be measured.

- Severity: error or notice.
- Typical cause: Insufficient inherited text or status ink contrast, missing tint, or unparseable tokens.
- Proposed fix ops: `author`, `adopt`, `derive`.
- Next action: Propose consumer-approved token changes or a registered derivation, then recheck icon contrast in both modes.

## A10

Image ratio, content metadata or delivery budget fails or needs review.

- Severity: error or notice.
- Typical cause: Invalid ratio dimensions; supplied image records show crop mismatch, absent alt text, baked corners or an unverified format/weight budget.
- Proposed fix ops: `author`.
- Next action: Use consumer-supplied crop choices. Obtain image and delivery evidence separately: the library CLI does not supply image records, so its result does not prove alt text, crops or byte budgets for deployed images.

## A11

Identity clear space or minimum size fails or is unmeasured.

- Severity: error or notice.
- Typical cause: Insufficient or absent measurable clear-space and size declarations.
- Proposed fix ops: `author`, `adopt`, `derive`.
- Next action: Obtain real artwork measurements and propose valid variants or derivations; send unresolved measurements to the owner.

## A12

An asset leaf is incomplete, mixes identity sources or has invalid derivations.

- Severity: error.
- Typical cause: Missing required materialized members, inconsistent logo artwork sources, or identity derivation errors.
- Proposed fix ops: `adopt`, `author`, `derive`.
- Next action: Propose complete leaf fills from a consistent artwork source and rerun registered derivations with current inputs.

## R

Reserved finding code; the current engine emits no R finding.

- Severity: reserved; no current emitted severity.
- Typical cause: The public Finding type reserves this code without a current runtime check.
- Proposed fix ops: none.
- Next action: Report the original finding and emitting version to the package maintainer. Do not invent a meaning, severity or automatic fix.

## Derived surface dogfood

DF codes belong to DogfoodFinding, independently of the library engine's Finding codes. These static findings do not certify runtime behavior. Dynamic classes, styles and spreads remain unresolved findings. Structural wrappers may have no look of their own; token utilities still require declared reads.

## DF1

Raw interactive or visually styled non-library element.

- Next action: Bind an existing component; triage a NEED when no capability exists.

## DF2

Hard-coded style value or unresolved dynamic styling/source.

- Next action: Use token-bound library surfaces. Same-line token-gate:ignore comments retain explicit ignored evidence.

## DF3

Inline SVG bypasses the assets component boundary.

- Next action: Bind an assets component or icon id.

## DF4

A token or asset read is unknown, or an observed read or composition edge is absent from the authored slot contract.

- Next action: Reconcile the observed read or composition with the authored contract; preserve the source evidence.

## DF5

A visual import or local component resolves to no registered slot.

- Next action: Bind a registered component or triage a NEED; preserve actual import provenance.

## DF7

A page hand-builds frame-owned heading or navigation chrome.

- Next action: Use PageHeaderModule and library heading/Panel parts.

## DF8

A page has no imported Frame page-header lease.

- Next action: Render exactly one PageHeaderModule from the public shell contract with id and header data.

## DF6

A named exception is missing, changed or expired.

- Next action: Resolve the gap or explicitly renew its file, element, hash, reason, owner and expiry evidence.
